id: bigtech:due to need for absolute success china delays critical moon :2026-08-23T14:30:16.000Z
title: Due to need for 'absolute success,' China delays critical Moon launch to 2027
author: Eric Berger
summary_long: China's "Manned Space" program issued a terse announcement on Sunday regarding its much-anticipated Chang’e 7 lunar exploration mission. The agency stated: "In keeping with the principle of proceeding prudently and reliably, and ensuring absolute success, after a comprehensive assessment it has been determined that the Chang’e 7 mission does not meet the conditions for launch and therefore cannot be carried out during the planned launch window this year." The Chinese message offered no explanation for the cause of the delay from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, located on an island in the South China Sea. Consisting of a lunar orbiter, lander, rover, and a mini-hopper of a probe, the mission was due to launch as early as Sunday on a Long March 5 rocket. It is intended to land at the South Pole of the Moon. Source: arstechnica.com. Date: 2026-08-23. Why it matters: outline likely impact on technology, business, or society. id: bigtech:gta vi all the news on rockstars next entry in the grand the:2026-08-23T19:14:37.000Z
title: GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar’s next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series
author: Verge Staff
summary_long: It’s been over a decade and two console generations since GTA V came out, and its sequel is still a work in progress. GTA VI has faced multiple delays, with developer Rockstar Games bumping back its predicted release date twice, first to May 26th, 2026, then again to November 19th, 2026, a full year after its originally planned release window of fall 2025, and facing accusations of union busting after firing more than 30 employees. Now, preorders have opened for the digital code-only game, offering the $79.99 standard edition and $99.99 Ultimate Edition on both PS5 and Xbox Series X / S. Early official glimpses offered a look at the game’s protagonists, Jason and Lucia, as the game will follow the pair around Vice City as they attempt to navigate a criminal conspiracy after a job goes south. Source: www.theverge.com. Date: 2026-08-23. Why it matters: outline likely impact on technology, business, or society.
